articles.body:
Hi,

We added four new caseworkers to the grants unit yesterday. Three of them get "No matching account" when they sign in through our ADFS, the fourth works fine. All four were created the same way in our directory.

Could you check what Grantly receives for them?

--
Per Ek
IT, Nordstad kommun
per.ek@nordstad.se | 070-555 21 08
articles.subject: SSO login fails for newly created caseworkers

articles.body:
Hi Per,

Thanks for the details. In the SAML assertions we receive for the three failing users the mail attribute is empty, only userPrincipalName is set. We match on mail, which is why the fourth one works.

Could you check whether the mailbox had been provisioned at the time the accounts were synced?

Regards,
Jonas Frid
Minso
articles.subject: Re: SSO login fails for newly created caseworkers

articles.body:
You were right. The mailboxes were provisioned about an hour after the accounts. I forced a resync this morning and all three can log in now.

Thanks for the quick look.

/Per
articles.subject: Re: SSO login fails for newly created caseworkers

articles.body:
Good to hear. I am closing this one.

For the future: if you provision in bulk, wait for the mailbox before syncing, or we can switch the matching attribute to UPN. Just say the word.

Regards,
Jonas
